causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Both Wallerawang units were offline on the day. Wallerawang unit seven had been scheduled to return to service from a three day outage at midnight on 9 August.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: On the day there was a planned outage of the Mt Piper to Marulan line.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: Over a number of rebids, Delta Electricity delayed the return to service of the Wallerawang unit seven from midnight on 9 August to 8.35 am on 10 August.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: At 8.17 am, Snowy Hydro rebid 1382 MW across Tumut Three and Upper Tumut from prices above $285/MWh down to prices close to the floor price.

causes.label: ramp_rates
causes.quote: The ramp up rate was also decreased from 3 MW/min to as low as zero for the period up to 10 am.

causes.label: ramp_rates
causes.quote: At 8.22 am, Snowy Hydro rebid the ramp down rate at Tumut Three and Upper Tumut from 200 MW/min and 130 MW/min, respectively, to the minimum allowable level of 3 MW/min.

causes.label: constraint_violation
causes.quote: The N>>N-MNMP_ONE_1 outage constraint and the N>>N-NIL_PRE36__S system normal constraint violated from 8.20 am to 8.35 am.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: The reduced capability across the Mt Piper to Wallerawang lines reduced the dispatch of low-priced generation and forced flows out of New South Wales into Victoria and Queensland.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: The congestion on the Mt Piper to Wallerawang lines led to prices at the price cap in New South Wales and forced exports into Queensland and Victoria counter-price.

constraints_named.quote: The constraint equation N>>N-MNMP_ONE_1 was invoked to managed the flows across the Mt Piper to Wallerawang lines as a result of the outage.
The N>>N-MNMP_ONE_1 outage constraint and the N>>N-NIL_PRE36__S system normal constraint violated from 8.20 am to 8.35 am.
